content: Naftifine hydrochloride is a topical medication prescribed to treat skin infections such as athlete's foot, jock itch, and ringworm. In some cases, it may be prescribed for other conditions. If you have questions about its use, consult your doctor or pharmacist for more information. Naftifine is available as a cream or gel for application to the skin. The cream is typically applied once daily, while the gel is applied twice daily, in the morning and evening, for a duration of 2 to 4 weeks. Certain infections may require up to 6 weeks of treatment. Follow the instructions on your prescription label carefully, and ask your doctor or pharmacist if you have any questions. Use naftifine exactly as directed. Do not use more or less of it, or apply it more frequently than prescribed by your doctor. Before application, thoroughly clean the affected area, allow it to dry, and gently rub the medication into the skin until most of it disappears. Use only enough medication to cover the affected area. Wash your hands after applying the medication. Continue using naftifine even if your symptoms improve. Do not stop using it without consulting your doctor. Before using naftifine, inform your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to naftifine or any other medications. Provide a list of all prescription and nonprescription drugs you are taking, including vitamins. Notify your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. If you become pregnant while using naftifine, contact your doctor immediately. If you forget to apply a dose, use it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not apply a double dose to make up for a missed one. Naftifine may cause side effects. If you experience itching, burning, irritation, stinging, redness, dryness, or a rash, contact your doctor immediately. If you experience a serious side effect, you or your doctor can report it to the FDA's MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online or by phone. Store this medication in its original container, tightly closed, and out of reach of children. Keep it at room temperature, away from excessive heat and moisture (do not store it in the bathroom). Dispose of any outdated or no longer needed medication properly. Consult your pharmacist for guidance on proper disposal. Keep all appointments with your doctor while using this medication. Naftifine is for external use only. Avoid contact with your eyes, nose, or mouth, and do not swallow it. Do not apply dressings, bandages, cosmetics, lotions, or other skin medications to the treated area unless directed by your doctor. Do not share this medication with others. If you have questions about refilling your prescription, ask your pharmacist. If your symptoms persist after completing the course of naftifine, contact your doctor.
